section: Nebraska corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate
note: Flat 4.55% on all Nebraska taxable income for tax years beginning in 2026 (LB 754 phase-down: 5.20% in 2025, 3.99% from 2027).
source_title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: 2023 Nebraska Legislative Changes (LB 754, corporate rate change)

section: Nebraska corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate from 2027
note: Scheduled final step of the phase-down; applies to tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2027.
source_title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: 2023 Nebraska Legislative Changes (LB 754, corporate rate change)

label: Levied by
value: County government, school districts, cities, community colleges, natural resource districts and other local authorities (levies set by the county board of equalization by October 15)
note: Each subdivision's rate = its budget tax request divided by its total taxable value.
source_title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Nebraska Property Assessment FAQs

label: State oversight
value: Nebraska Department of Revenue, Property Assessment Division (directed by the Property Tax Administrator)
note: Also administers the homestead exemption, the Property Tax Credit Act and the documentary stamp tax.
source_title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Property Assessment Division, Purpose

label: Assessment level
value: Real property at or near 100% of actual value; agricultural and horticultural land at or near 75%
note: Property tax is levied locally; these are the rules the state sets. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Nebraska Property Assessment FAQs

label: Documentary stamp tax rate
value: $3.32 per $1,000 (or fraction) of the value transferred
note: Raised from $2.32 on July 18, 2026 (LB 1067), which reverts the rate to $2.32 on January 1, 2032. Deeds recorded January 1 to July 17, 2026 paid $2.32.
source_title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Documentary Stamp Tax Rate History

label: Who pays the documentary stamp tax
value: Grantor (seller), collected by the county register of deeds when the deed is recorded
note: Taxes on the transfer of real estate. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Documentary Stamp Tax
